notes.style: Ronnie Fieg's taste is the product; the clothing exists to express a point of view.
notes.craft: Kith's own-label product pages give composition and fabric weight but, for apparel, no country of make ('See garment tag'); in a sample of seven only a leather card holder said 'Made in Italy'. The site names no factory, no mill and no owned facility, so there is almost nothing checkable about who makes Kith clothing.

cities: 15 stores, including Brooklyn, New York, Beverly Hills, and its own site

craft_evidence.owned_d: No factory, workshop or mill of Kith's own found: the site has no about/making page, the FAQ (kithnyc.gorgias.help) covers shipping, returns, drawings only, and a press search found nothing about owned production.
craft_evidence.countries: Italy 1/7 (Monogram Suede Card Holder 'Made in Italy'); none 6/7 (Classic Logo Nelson Hoodie x2, Circuit Nelson Hoodie, &Kin Cashmere Raya blazer, Knicks Patchwork Crewneck, Orosei sunglasses; apparel PDPs say 'See garment tag'). Sample of 7 Kith-label PDPs: fleece, knit, tailoring, leather goods, eyewear. Several other PDP URLs from search returned 404.
